Hi I'm Kholoud, a high school student passionate about space, science, and technology. I'm the leader of Beyond Earth, participating in NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026.

I have basic knowledge of Java, HTML, and CSS, as well as research skills. I'm eager to learn and collaborate.

Our team explores similarities between Earth, Mars, and the Moon. We're looking for teammates with skills in web development, graphic design, astronomy, or planetary science.
summary: Beyond the Earth is an interactive educational website that compares environmental conditions at three selected locations: Llano de Chajnantor on Earth, Shackleton Crater on the Moon, and Jezero Crater on Mars. The project uses scientific data and visual charts to explore similarities and differences in solar radiation, temperature, and other environmental factors. By making complex space data easier to understand, Beyond the Earth helps users explore the challenges of different planetary environments and understand how comparing these locations can support future space exploration and research.
details:
How the Project Works

Beyond the Earth is an interactive educational website designed to compare environmental conditions across three locations: Llano de Chajnantor on Earth, Shackleton Crater on the Moon, and Jezero Crater on Mars.

The website presents scientific information through organized sections, data comparisons, and interactive charts. Users can explore each location separately and compare environmental factors to understand the similarities and differences between these environments.

Benefits and Expected Impact

The project makes complex planetary and environmental data easier to understand and explore. It encourages scientific curiosity, supports space science education, and helps users understand the environmental challenges involved in exploring different worlds.

Its expected impact is to make space-related scientific data more accessible and inspire interest in planetary research and future space exploration.

Tools and Technologies

The project was developed using:

- HTML to structure the website.
- CSS to design the layout and visual appearance.
- JavaScript to add interactivity and display data visualizations.
- Chart.js for creating visual charts.
- NASA open data and scientific references for the environmental comparisons.

The project was developed using software tools and a computer. It does not require specialized hardware.

Creativity and Innovation

The creative aspect of Beyond the Earth is bringing three different worlds together in one interactive experience. Instead of presenting scientific information as separate facts, the website allows users to explore and compare real locations across Earth, the Moon, and Mars through visual data and accessible explanations.

Design Considerations

Our team considered data accessibility, scientific reliability, clarity, and ease of use. We aimed to present information in a simple and engaging way while making the comparisons understandable for users without an advanced scientific background.
